ads.text:
(Telugu - translated) 'Enter your details for solar subsidy details up to Rs.78,000.'

FB.ME card (Telugu - translated): 'Solar with up to Rs.78,000 subsidy! Your own power plant on your own roof! Through PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, eligible household consumers can get a subsidy of up to Rs.78,000*. Rooftop Solar Installation / savings on electricity bills.'

Ad Library note: '2 ads use this creative and text'; the page listing shows ~1 result. Creative is a video.

ad_library.summary: 1 live Meta ad confirmed on 2026-11-21 on the Aadithya Solar Energies page (page ID 586497644535912): library ID 1596852225147259, started 11 Sep 2026 - 71 days at the time of this report - with 2 ads using this creative and text. Telugu copy sells Rs.78,000 subsidy details and clicks to a Facebook lead form (FB.ME). The website was read live the same day; it is still running the demo content of the commercial theme it was built on. Google Ads Transparency records were not checked in this pass.

funnel.meaning: The only live ad ends in a Facebook lead form, so the site is never reached from paid traffic - which is fortunate, because the site's own buttons send visitors to the theme vendor's demo pages. Nothing in this funnel can be measured end to end.

findings: The site's header still shows the theme demo's US phone number - 'Call Us: (229) 555-0109' - while the real number, +91 9491032828, appears only in the footer. A Hyderabad buyer sees an American placeholder at the top of the page.

Every 'explore more', 'Browse all services', 'Get A Fre Quote' button and several navigation and service links point at themexriver.com/wp/eergx/... - the theme vendor's demo site. The site's own buttons walk visitors off the domain.

The page is still running its software-agency template: 'We are 100+ professional software engineers with more than 10 years of experience... Mobile app easy management', counters labelled 'Busines setup growth', 'Business Problem Solvingh' and 'Commitment to Clean 4%', prices written as '$4/Kw on grid' and '17/Kw Hybrid', and lorem text ('Every pleasure is to be welcomed and every pain avoided') under the offer blocks.

The testimonials are demo names from the template and one of them appears twice ('Arjun Das, Warangal' on two different quotes), while the 'Join Our Team' recruitment block and the 'We Give Unparalleled Flexibility' block each appear twice on the same page.

Three different addresses are published: Sy.No.186, near Water Tank, Kismatpur, Gandipet Mandal, Ranga Reddy 500086 (footer); Plot No.42, Himayath Sagar, Bandlaguda Jagir, Gandipet Mandal 500086 (contact page); and 1-284/5 Srikalahasti-Pichatur Road, Srikalahasti, Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh 517644 (footer).

The only ad has been running since 11 Sep 2026 - 71 days - with 2 ads on a single creative, pointed at a lead form, while the site it should be sending people to still carries the header phone of its theme vendor. On top of that, the ad's form asks for 'solar subsidy details', but the site has no subsidy page beyond one FAQ line.

The site's 'Quick Contact' form asks the visitor to pick a 'Service type' from rupee bands ('Less Than 1000 Rs', '1000-2500 Rs'... 'More Than 7500 Rs') - a software-agency pricing dropdown that a solar buyer cannot answer.
next_steps: Remove '(229) 555-0109' from the header and put +91 9491032828 there. It is a five-minute change and it is the first thing on the page.
Repoint every theme link at a real page
'Explore more', 'Browse all services', 'Get A Fre Quote' and the nav items currently send visitors to themexriver.com. That is free traffic being handed to the theme vendor.
Strip the demo content before spending another rupee
Software-agency copy, '$4/Kw' prices, lorem text, duplicate testimonials and a repeated recruitment block. Replace them with two real projects, a real price and one form.
Build the subsidy page the ad promises
The ad sells 'solar subsidy details'. Publish one page: the Rs.78,000 slab, eligibility, the documents needed and what you handle - then point the ad there with a Meta Pixel and UTMs.
Refresh the creative and settle on one address
71 days on one creative with no variation is a wasted learning budget. And pick the address you actually operate from - the site currently publishes three.

site_audit.platform: WordPress on the commercial 'eergx' theme (ThemeXriver), demo content still published
site_audit.scope_note: The website was read live on 2026-11-21 through a rendered-content fetch of the home page and /contact. Tracking-pixel and head checks (Meta Pixel, GA4, GTM, Google Ads, meta description, Open Graph, JSON-LD, favicon) need the raw served HTML and were not captured through this channel, so they are recorded as not checked rather than absent. PageSpeed and sitemap were not run.

issues: No WhatsApp link — losing mobile leads (WhatsApp converts 3x better for Indian home services)
No live chat — missing after-hours leads

site_evidence.note: Head HTML not captured through the sandbox fetch channel; pixel presence is not checked, not asserted absent. No UTM parameters appear on any link in the rendered page content, and the ad lands on fb.me, which cannot carry them.

promise_gap.promise: 'Enter your details for solar subsidy details up to Rs.78,000' (the ad's only line, in Telugu)
promise_gap.site: There is no subsidy page. The Rs.78,000 figure appears once, inside an FAQ accordion, and nowhere on the enquiry path - so the ad's promise is answered by a form, not by information.

promise_gap.promise: 'Your own power plant on your own roof' (FB.ME card line, in Telugu)
promise_gap.site: The site's offer blocks carry '$4/Kw on grid' and '17/Kw Hybrid' with lorem text underneath - no system size, no total price, no subsidy-adjusted price that a buyer could act on.

promise_gap.promise: 'Rooftop Solar Installation' (listed benefit in the ad)
promise_gap.site: Installation is one of four service cards, and every card's link points at the theme vendor's demo site rather than a page about the work.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
